title: R' Shimon ben Zira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Kiddushin 76b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.76b.8), teaching in the Kiddushin collection of the school of Levi. Hyman also cites Tanchuma, Bereshit 3. It appears to Hyman that the name should read R' Shimon ben Nezira.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Kiddushin reads Rav Shimon bar Zeira and gives Jerusalem as the scope of the teaching from Levi’s school. The named notice did not turn up in the consulted editions of Tanchuma, Bereshit 3.

[Shabbat](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.33b.4) and [Yerushalmi Shekalim](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.5.5) separately give Shimon ben Nezira. [Heilprin’s Nezira entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3475&lang=en) cites both passages.
Hyman proposes Nezira for the name in this entry. The attestations of that name leave the proposed correction open.
